summary: The proof correctly identifies the triangular scaling limit of every fixed superlevel set, uses a uniform halfplane lattice-discrepancy bound to pass the depth infimum and squared Riemann sums to area depth, and supplies a valid integrable domination over all levels. The triangle-depth moment, dilation, layer substitution, mass asymptotics, and final constants all check exactly, and applying the resulting limit at dimension two gives the stated necessary bound on kappa.
